[On K.O.] You may trash 2 cards from your hand: Play this Character card from your trash.

735246.Description:
Under the rules of this game, you may have any number of this card in your deck.
[Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)

735247.Description:
Under the rules of this game, you may have any number of this card in your deck.
[Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)

735248.Description: [On Play] Add up to 1 card with a type including "CP" from your hand to the top or bottom of your Life cards face-up.

735249.Description: [On Play] Draw 1 card, then add up to 1 card with a type including "CP" from your hand to the top or bottom of your Life cards face-up.

735250.Description: [On Play]/[On K.O.] Trash up to 1 card from the top of your opponent's Life cards.

735251.Description:
[On K.O.] You may trash 1 card from your hand: Play this Character card from your trash.
[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] If this Character was played on this turn, play up to 1 {Holy Knights of God} type Character card with a cost of 6 or less from your trash.

735252.Description:
[On Play] Draw 1 card.
[Once Per Turn] When your Leader with a type including "Rocks Pirates" attacks or is attacked, you may trash 1 card from your hand to activate this effect. Your Leader gains +3000 power during this battle.

735253.Description:
[On Play] Look at 4 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Holy Knights of God} type card and add it to your hand. Then, trash the rest.
[Activate: Main] You may rest 4 of your DON!! cards: Play up to 1 {Holy Knights of God} type Character card with a cost of 6 or less from your trash.

735254.Description: [On Play] Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters and that Character will not become active in your opponent's next Refresh Phase. Then, if your opponent has 2 or more rested Characters, your Leader gains +2000 power until the end of your opponent's next End Phase.

735271.Description: [On Play] DON!! 4, you may trash 1 card from your hand: Add up to 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards. Then, up to 1 of your opponent's Characters' base power becomes 0 during this turn.

735272.Description:
Apply each of the following effects based on this Character's power:
• If it has 5000 power or more, this Character gains [Rush].
• If it has 6000 power or more, this Character gains [Banish].
• If it has 7000 power or more, this Character gains [Unblockable].

735273.Description:
[Opponent's Turn] If your Character would be removed from the field by your opponent's effect, you may rest this Character instead.
[End of Your Turn] Set up to 1 of your {Water Seven} type cards and up to 1 of your DON!! cards as active.
